warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: One flat can wrap, so there is a single image; the mandatory text sits at the left of it.

The brand is one brush-script lockup: 'Hop' over 'Butcher' in mixed case, with a brushed banner directly beneath carrying 'FOR THE WORLD' in capitals. The reading above keeps both parts, because they are elements of a single mark rather than two names printed in different places.
The bottom right line reads 'ALC. 8.0% BY VOL. | ONE PINT (16 FL OZ)' with a vertical bar between the two statements.
Net contents spells the quantity in words, 'ONE PINT', with '(16 FL OZ)' after it and no full stops in FL OZ.
Warning is set in capitals in a condensed serif; the heading 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:' is larger than the body.
